map.简化版人机五子棋，AI 按周围棋势打分。: A simplified human-vs-AI Gomoku; the AI scores points by surrounding board momentum.
map.五子棋 AI 按棋型评分选点：活四（必胜）权重 10000、冲四 1000、活三: The Gomoku AI scores candidate moves by pattern: open four (winning) weight 10000, rush four 1000, open three 1000, sleeping three 100, open two 100, sleeping two 10; candidate score = own five-threat score × attack factor + opponent threat score × defense factor; on a 15×15 board it scores every empty point within 2 cells of an existing stone and takes the maximum, optionally combined with minimax search and alpha-beta pruning.
map.人机对战：与内置 AI 轮流落子，先连五子胜，适合单人练棋。: Play against the computer: alternate moves with the built-in AI, and the first to connect five wins — good for solo practice.
map.策略观察：观察 AI 如何按棋型权重启发式（进攻 1.0 / 防守 1.15）优: Strategy observation: watch how the AI uses pattern weights (attack 1.0 / defense 1.15) to block open fours and contest open threes, and get a feel for heuristic play.
map.算法演示：观察 AI 如何优先堵活四、抢活三，理解启发式博弈。: Algorithm demo: watch how the AI prioritizes blocking open fours and contesting open threes to understand heuristic play.
map.；AI 启发式评估棋盘：优先成五 > 堵对方活四 > 自己做活四/活三 > 堵冲: ; the AI heuristically evaluates the board: complete five first > block the opponent's open four > make its own open four/three > block a rush four. There is a single difficulty level (no search-depth parameter), scoring by pattern weights.
map.玩家在 (3,3)(3,4)(3,5) 做成活三，AI 优先堵 (3,2) 或: If the player builds an open three at (3,3)(3,4)(3,5), the AI first blocks (3,2) or (3,6) to stop a four; if the player also has another open three at (5,5)(6,6), the AI can only block one, and the player completes five in the other direction to win. Creating a double open three is the key to beating the AI.
map.启发式评估（进攻 1.0 / 防守 1.15 权重），单层棋型打分，不加深层搜索: Heuristic evaluation (attack 1.0 / defense 1.15 weights) with single-layer pattern scoring and no deep search; strong players can force mistakes with double open threes or rush fours.
map.能调整先手吗？: Can I change who moves first?
map.玩家固定执黑先手，AI 执白后手应战；当前不提供先手切换与难度调节，定位为单一难: The player always plays black and moves first, with the AI playing white; there is currently no side switching or difficulty adjustment, and it is positioned as single-level practice.
